title: 6-hour rolling mean (device 1)
task: Set result to a Series of the 6-period rolling mean of device 1's value (sorted by ts, NaNs dropped), rounded to 3 decimals, indexed by ts.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts').set_index('ts')
result = d['value'].rolling(6).mean().dropna().round(3)

title: Rolling std spike (device 1)
task: Set result to the maximum 6-period rolling std (ddof=1) of device 1's value, rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
result = round(float(d['value'].rolling(6).std().max()), 3)

title: Z-score anomalies per device
context: Flag readings far from the device mean.
task: Set result to a DataFrame reading_id, device_id, value of readings whose value is more than 3 device-standard-deviations from the device mean (population std, ddof=0), sorted by reading_id.
answer:
r = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
mu = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform('mean')
sd = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.std(ddof=0))
z = (r['value'] - mu) / sd
result = r.loc[z.abs() > 3, ['reading_id', 'device_id', 'value']].sort_values('reading_id').reset_index(drop=True)

title: Anomaly count per device
task: Set result to a Series of the number of >3σ anomalies (population std) per device_id, only devices with at least one, sorted descending.
hint: same z logic, groupby device sum.
answer:
r = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
mu = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform('mean')
sd = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.std(ddof=0))
r['anom'] = (r['value'] - mu).abs() / sd > 3
a = r.groupby('device_id')['anom'].sum()
result = a[a > 0].sort_values(ascending=False)

title: Rolling-median outliers (device 1)
task: Set result to the number of device 1 readings whose value differs from its 7-period centered rolling median by more than 10 (an int; ignore edge NaNs).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
med = d['value'].rolling(7, center=True).median()
result = int(((d['value'] - med).abs() > 10).sum())

title: Longest reporting gap (device 1)
task: Set result to the largest gap in hours between consecutive device 1 readings (an int), sorted by ts.
hint: sort ts, diff, max in hours.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
gap = d['ts'].diff().dt.total_seconds() / 3600
result = int(gap.max())

title: Number of outages (device 1)
context: A gap over 1 hour is an outage.
task: Set result to the number of consecutive-reading gaps greater than 1 hour for device 1 (an int).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
gap = d['ts'].diff().dt.total_seconds() / 3600
result = int((gap > 1).sum())

title: Resample with gap fill (device 1)
task: Set result to the number of missing hourly slots after resampling device 1 to a strict hourly grid (an int) = count of NaN values after resample('h').mean() over its full range.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].dropna(subset=['value']).set_index('ts').sort_index()
g = d['value'].resample('h').mean()
result = int(g.isna().sum())

title: Daily min/max range (device 1)
task: Set result to a Series indexed by day of (daily max − daily min) value for device 1, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by day.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].set_index('ts').sort_index()['value']
ag = d.resample('D').agg(['max', 'min'])
result = (ag['max'] - ag['min']).round(3)

title: Rate of change (device 1)
task: Set result to the maximum absolute hour-over-hour change in device 1's value (sorted by ts), rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
result = round(float(d['value'].diff().abs().max()), 3)

title: Consecutive breach runs (device 1)
task: Set result to the length of the longest run of consecutive device 1 readings (by ts) that are out of range for temperature (value <15 or >30) (an int; ignore missing by treating them as not-breach).
hint: breach series, group by run, max run of True.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
breach = ((d['value'] < 15) | (d['value'] > 30)).fillna(False).astype(int)
grp = (breach != breach.shift()).cumsum()
runs = breach.groupby(grp).sum()
result = int(runs.max())

title: EWMA smoothing (device 1)
task: Set result to the last value of device 1's exponentially weighted moving average (span=6) of value (sorted by ts, drop missing first), rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].dropna(subset=['value']).sort_values('ts')
result = round(float(d['value'].ewm(span=6).mean().iloc[-1]), 3)

title: Hour-of-day x device heatmap
task: Set result to a pivot_table: index device_id, columns ts hour-of-day, values mean value, rounded to 2 decimals, fill_value 0.
answer:
r = readings.copy()
r['hour'] = r['ts'].dt.hour
result = r.pivot_table(index='device_id', columns='hour', values='value', aggfunc='mean', fill_value=0).round(2)

title: Cumulative breach count (device 1)
task: Set result to the total number of out-of-range temperature readings for device 1 across the whole log (an int; value<15 or >30, ignore missing).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1]
result = int((((d['value'] < 15) | (d['value'] > 30)) & d['value'].notna()).sum())

title: Site-level daily average
task: Set result to a Series indexed by day of the mean value across all Plant-A devices per calendar day, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by day.
hint: merge site, filter Plant-A, groupby day mean.
answer:
m = readings.merge(devices, on='device_id')
p = m[m['site'] == 'Plant-A']
result = p.groupby(p['ts'].dt.normalize())['value'].mean().round(3)

title: Battery vs time correlation
task: Set result to the Pearson correlation between the hour offset (0..N) and battery for device 1 (sorted by ts), rounded to 3 decimals.
hint: reset index as x, corr with battery.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].dropna(subset=['battery']).sort_values('ts').reset_index(drop=True)
result = round(float(pd.Series(range(len(d))).corr(d['battery'].reset_index(drop=True))), 3)

title: Time to first breach (device 1)
context: When did it first go out of range?
task: Set result to the ts (Timestamp) of device 1's first out-of-range temperature reading (value<15 or >30).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1]
br = d[((d['value'] < 15) | (d['value'] > 30)) & d['value'].notna()]
result = br['ts'].min()

title: Rolling 24h mean crossing (device 1)
task: Set result to the number of readings where device 1's value exceeds its trailing 24-period rolling mean by more than 5 (an int; ignore NaN windows).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')
roll = d['value'].rolling(24).mean()
result = int(((d['value'] - roll) > 5).sum())

title: Value percentiles per kind
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by kind with columns p50 and p95 (50th and 95th percentiles of value, 2 dp), computed over non-missing readings.
answer:
m = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).merge(devices, on='device_id')
result = m.groupby('kind')['value'].quantile([0.5, 0.95]).unstack().round(2)
result.columns = ['p50', 'p95']

title: Devices below uptime SLA
task: Set result to a Series of device_id and reading count for devices reporting fewer than 0.95*504 readings, sorted ascending by count.
answer:
c = readings.groupby('device_id').size()
result = c[c < 0.95 * 504].sort_values()

title: Peak-to-peak per day (device 1)
task: Set result to the maximum daily peak-to-peak (max−min) value for device 1 across all its days, rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].set_index('ts').sort_index()['value']
ag = d.resample('D').agg(['max', 'min'])
result = round(float((ag['max'] - ag['min']).max()), 3)

title: Normalised value (z per device)
task: Set result to readings (non-missing) with a column zval = (value − device mean)/device std (ddof=0), rounded to 3 dp; keep reading_id, device_id, zval.
answer:
r = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
mu = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform('mean')
sd = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.std(ddof=0))
r['zval'] = ((r['value'] - mu) / sd).round(3)
result = r[['reading_id', 'device_id', 'zval']]

title: Hourly fleet average
context: All devices, hourly mean over time.
task: Set result to a Series indexed by hour timestamp of the mean value across all devices, resampled hourly, rounded to 3 decimals, for the first 12 hours.
answer:
d = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).set_index('ts').sort_index()
result = d['value'].resample('h').mean().round(3).head(12)

title: Battery life projection (device 1)
context: Hours until battery hits 0 at current drain rate.
task: Using device 1's battery drain per hour (slope from a linear fit of battery on hour offset), set result to the estimated hours from the last reading until battery reaches 0, rounded to 1 decimal. If the slope is >= 0, set result to -1.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].dropna(subset=['battery']).sort_values('ts').reset_index(drop=True)
x = np.arange(len(d))
slope = np.polyfit(x, d['battery'], 1)[0]
result = -1 if slope >= 0 else round(float(d['battery'].iloc[-1] / -slope), 1)

title: Readings by hour-block
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per 6-hour block label ('00-05','06-11','12-17','18-23'), sorted by block.
answer:
blk = (readings['ts'].dt.hour // 6).map({0: '00-05', 1: '06-11', 2: '12-17', 3: '18-23'})
result = blk.value_counts().sort_index()

title: Device summary
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by device_id with readings (count), avg_value (mean value, 3 dp) and missing (count of null values), sorted by device_id.
hint: agg with count/mean and a lambda for nulls.
answer:
result = readings.groupby('device_id').agg(readings=('reading_id', 'count'), avg_value=('value', 'mean'), missing=('value', lambda s: s.isna().sum()))
result['avg_value'] = result['avg_value'].round(3)
result = result.sort_index()

title: Rolling range alarm (device 1)
context: Flag windows with a big swing.
task: Set result to the number of 6-period windows for device 1 where the rolling (max − min) exceeds 15 (an int; ignore NaN windows).
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].sort_values('ts')['value']
rng = d.rolling(6).max() - d.rolling(6).min()
result = int((rng > 15).sum())

title: Readings within 3h after maintenance
task: Set result to the total number of readings that fall within 3 hours after any maintenance event for the same device (an int).
hint: for each maint row, count device readings in (ts, ts+3h].
answer:
total = 0
for _, mrow in maintenance.iterrows():
    d = readings[readings['device_id'] == mrow['device_id']]
    total += int(((d['ts'] > mrow['ts']) & (d['ts'] <= mrow['ts'] + pd.Timedelta(hours=3))).sum())
result = total

title: Daily mean wide by device
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by day with one column per device_id holding that device's daily mean value, rounded to 2 dp, for the first 3 days (fill NaN with 0).
answer:
r = readings.copy()
r['day'] = r['ts'].dt.normalize()
p = r.pivot_table(index='day', columns='device_id', values='value', aggfunc='mean', fill_value=0).round(2)
result = p.head(3)

title: IQR outliers per kind
context: Tukey fences within each sensor type.
task: Set result to the number of readings that are IQR outliers within their kind (value < Q1−1.5·IQR or > Q3+1.5·IQR, quantiles per kind) (an int; non-missing only).
hint: merge kind, per-kind quantiles via transform.
answer:
m = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).merge(devices[['device_id', 'kind']], on='device_id')
q1 = m.groupby('kind')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.25))
q3 = m.groupby('kind')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.75))
iqr = q3 - q1
result = int(((m['value'] < q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | (m['value'] > q3 + 1.5 * iqr)).sum())

title: First time value exceeds 40 (device 1)
task: Set result to the ts (Timestamp) of the first device 1 reading with value > 40, or the string 'never' if none.
answer:
d = readings[(readings['device_id'] == 1) & (readings['value'] > 40)]
result = d['ts'].min() if len(d) else 'never'

title: Downsample to 6-hourly (device 1)
task: Set result to a Series of device 1's value resampled to 6-hourly means ('6h'), rounded to 3 dp, for the first 8 buckets.
answer:
d = readings[readings['device_id'] == 1].dropna(subset=['value']).set_index('ts').sort_index()
result = d['value'].resample('6h').mean().round(3).head(8)

title: Most anomalous site
context: Which site has the most >3σ readings?
task: Set result to the site (str) with the most >3σ anomalies (population std computed per device), across its devices.
hint: z per device, merge site, groupby site sum, idxmax.
answer:
r = readings.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
mu = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform('mean')
sd = r.groupby('device_id')['value'].transform(lambda s: s.std(ddof=0))
r['anom'] = (r['value'] - mu).abs() / sd > 3
m = r.merge(devices[['device_id', 'site']], on='device_id')
result = m.groupby('site')['anom'].sum().idxmax()
